parameters.content:
## Automation 3 — Qualifier and meeting booker
Replace the placeholders in the email nodes before going live: **booking link** (Google Calendar appointment page), **resource link**, **Your Name**.

• Interested leads (from A2 or the website form) get 4 qualifying questions within 5 min.
• Claude scores the answers and routes: booking link with 3 free times / nurture / close-out / hand to rep.
• A new event on the rep calendar with the lead as guest marks *Meeting booked* and confirms.
• Reminders 24h and 1h before; brief to Slack 1h before.
• 45 min after the call, the rep logs the outcome in Slack → *Proposal needed* feeds A4.
